droppedReason: The `*-opacity-*` utilities were REMOVED in Tailwind v4, and the
upgrade codemod did not migrate this one. `bg-black bg-opacity-50`
This is the one place the class-by-class probe cannot express the
change: in v3 the colour and the opacity were TWO classes, and in v4
they are ONE. Probed alone, `bg-opacity-50` computes to a transparent
background (it sets a variable, not a colour) and `bg-black/50`
computes to `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)` — so the two are not equal, even
though the rendered element is identical.
